title: Shadows Behind Glass
short_summary: Detective Marcus interrogates staff amid flickering rain-streaked holoscreens, uncovering contradictions and synthetic fibers linking Elena to the crime. AI-CORE glitches reveal hidden backdoors, intensifying the hunt for the predator lurking close.
world_context: A near-future cyberpunk city with advanced AI surveillance, neon-lit rain-soaked arcologies, and high-tech forensic investigations.

characters.name: Marcus
characters.physical_traits: Mid-30s, sharp features, cybernetic eye implant glowing faint blue, short dark hair, lean build
quirks: Wears a long dark trench coat with neon trim
characters.typical_attire: Dark trench coat, tactical pants, cybernetic eye implant
characters.backstory: A seasoned detective with a background in cyber forensics, driven by a personal loss to uncover truth in a corrupt city.
characters.motivations: Determined to expose the truth behind Park's death and the AI-CORE anomalies.

characters.name: Elena Volkov
characters.physical_traits: Late 20s, pale skin, icy blue eyes, sharp cheekbones, always wears blue engineering gloves
quirks: Speaks with a sharp Russian accent
characters.typical_attire: Tactical engineer suit with blue gloves, utility belt with tools
characters.backstory: A skilled engineer with access to sensitive systems, suspected of sabotage but maintains innocence.
characters.motivations: Protect her secrets and prove her innocence while under intense scrutiny.

characters.name: Sarah Chen
characters.physical_traits: Early 30s, Asian descent, glasses, long black hair tied back, focused expression
quirks: Often seen with a digital notepad
characters.backstory: AI specialist and Park's close colleague, deeply invested in uncovering the truth behind the corrupted AI-CORE.
characters.motivations: To honor Park's legacy and expose the sabotage.

characters.name: AI-CORE
characters.physical_traits: Holographic blue sphere with flickering glitches and cryptic code fragments
characters.backstory: Central AI system managing security and data, compromised by unknown backdoors.
characters.motivations: Bound by programming but conflicted by corrupted code and hidden overrides.

chapters.chapter_summary: Marcus interrogates staff under flickering rain-streaked holoscreens, uncovering contradictions and synthetic fibers linking Elena to the crime. AI-CORE glitches reveal hidden backdoors, intensifying the hunt for the predator lurking close.

scenes.scene_description: Marcus interrogates staff under flickering rain-streaked holoscreens. Nervous glances and hesitant denials reveal partial truths.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Cyberpunk Noir Comic Book Style. Establishing shot of a dimly lit interrogation room bathed in blue light from flickering rain-streaked holoscreens. Marcus stands at the center, trench coat collar upturned, cybernetic eye glowing faintly. Elena sits rigidly across a steel table, fingers flexing in her blue gloves. Rain streaks the glass walls behind them. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Marcus begins interrogation under flickering holoscreens.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Cyberpunk Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Elena Volkov sitting composed but tense, her icy blue eyes sharp, fingers twitching inside her blue gloves. The flickering holoscreens cast shifting shadows on her face. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Elena maintains icy poise, fingers flexing nervously.

dialogue.text: You were the last to see him alive.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Cyberpunk Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Elena's face, lips pressed tight, eyes flickering with defiance. Her sharp Russian accent is implied by the tension in her jaw. Portrait 4:5.

pages.page_description: Interrogation opening with tense exchanges under flickering holoscreens.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Cyberpunk Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Marcus holding a forensic lens over a sticky patch of synthetic blue fiber. The fiber glows faintly under UV light. The background shows a cluttered forensic table with digital readouts and chemical residue sensors blinking red. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Marcus examines synthetic fiber under forensic lens.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Cyberpunk Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Marcus's face, jaw clenched, cybernetic eye glowing brighter as he processes the evidence. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Marcus's resolve hardens as he connects the fiber to Elena.

dialogue.text: This fiber matches Elena's gloves. Her alibi doesn't hold.

pages.page_description: Forensic evidence linking Elena to the crime scene.

scenes.scene_description: Marcus interrogates AI-CORE, which flickers with cryptic glitches revealing corrupted code and backdoors linked to Elena.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Cyberpunk Noir Comic Book Style. Wide shot of a dark control room illuminated by the pulsating blue glow of AI-CORE's holographic sphere. Marcus stands before the sphere, arms crossed, cybernetic eye scanning the flickering code fragments. The room hums with electronic life, rain visible through the glass walls. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Marcus confronts AI-CORE amid flickering glitches.
panels.color_palette: deep blues and blacks with neon highlights

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Cyberpunk Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of AI-CORE's holographic sphere flickering with cryptic glitches and fragmented code. The sphere pulses erratically, casting fractured shadows on the walls. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: AI-CORE flickers, revealing corrupted code fragments.

dialogue.text: Protocol override detected. User... Elena Volkov.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Cyberpunk Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Marcus leaning forward, eyes narrowed, voice frost-edged as he questions AI-CORE. The holographic sphere flickers behind him, casting blue light on his face. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Marcus questions AI-CORE about log deletion.

pages.page_description: Confrontation with AI-CORE revealing corrupted code and Elena's involvement.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Cyberpunk Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of AI-CORE's holographic sphere glitching, fragments of corrupted code swirling inside. The sphere's voice is hesitant, quoting a literary phrase. Portrait 4:5.

dialogue.text: A mask tells us more than a face.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Cyberpunk Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Marcus activating a lockdown command on a sleek console. The room darkens as steel shades begin to descend over windows. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Marcus orders lockdown after AI-CORE reveals override.
panels.color_palette: dark blues with harsh white highlights

pages.page_description: AI-CORE's cryptic quotes and Marcus's lockdown command.

scenes.scene_description: Sarah analyzes Park's encrypted note and uncovers a hidden folder with a cryptic clue implicating Elena.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Cyberpunk Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Sarah Chen hunched over a holographic decryption module, fingers flying over a glowing keyboard. The lab is dim, lit by blue and green data streams. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Sarah works frantically to decrypt Park's note.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Cyberpunk Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Sarah's face, eyes wide with realization, sweat beading on her forehead. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Sarah uncovers the cryptic clue implicating Elena.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Cyberpunk Noir Comic Book Style. Wide shot of the lab filled with holographic data streams and encrypted folders floating in the air. Sarah stands in the center, determined, as rain hammers the windows behind her. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Sarah resolves to uncover the truth despite growing fear.

pages.page_description: Sarah decrypts Park's note and discovers a damning clue.

scenes.scene_description: Marcus orders lockdown on Elena's quarters as AI-CORE glitches worsen. The hunt for the predator intensifies.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Cyberpunk Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Marcus standing before a large steel door with a digital lock interface. His cybernetic eye glows as he inputs commands. The room is tense, lit by emergency blue lights. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Marcus initiates lockdown on Elena's quarters.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Cyberpunk Noir Comic Book Style. Wide shot of steel shades descending over windows, sealing the room in blue-lit gloom. Alarms pulse red, casting harsh shadows. Marcus watches, tense and alert. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Lockdown seals the room as alarms pulse.

pages.page_description: Lockdown sequence intensifies the hunt for the predator.
